about: Every place the mashup touches either game. ES hooks are small calls added to the Endless Sky 0.11.2 source (GPLv3); DSP hooks are BepInEx/Harmony or MonoBehaviour points.

rows.trigger: game starts (not in tests or console runs)
rows.does: starts Dyson Sphere Program through Steam unless it is already running; never closes anything
writes landed event; if planet is claimed, lets DSP take focus

rows.trigger: player presses F on the planet screen
rows.does: if landed on an owned claim, re-announces the landing so DSP comes back to the front
notices a claim bought while landed, warns if DSP is not running, loads shipment files into the landed cargo pool, raises ES window on return
reads state; on a new claimed landing binds+travels mecha to the bound planet
writes heartbeat so ES knows whether a DSP game is loaded
empties shippable items from the claim planet's storage boxes into a shipment, hands focus back to ES
shows a Ship to Endless Sky switch; switched-on depots (saved per galaxy, planet and depot in LandingRights/spaceports.txt) are the only ones F8 ships from
